actions.description: Create a channel in Discord
actions.name: create-channel

guildId.description: The ID of the guild to create the channel in. Example: "41771983423143937"

type.description: The type of channel. Default is 0 (GUILD_TEXT). Options: 0 (GUILD_TEXT), 2 (GUILD_VOICE), 4 (GUILD_CATEGORY), 5 (GUILD_ANNOUNCEMENT), 13 (GUILD_STAGE_VOICE), 15 (GUILD_FORUM), 16 (GUILD_MEDIA).

bitrate.description: The bitrate of the voice channel (min 8000).

userLimit.description: The user limit of the voice channel.

rateLimitPerUser.description: Amount of seconds a user has to wait before sending another message (0-21600).

parentId.description: ID of the parent category for the channel.

rtcRegion.description: Channel voice region id, automatic when set to null.

videoQualityMode.description: Camera video quality mode (1 for auto, 2 for 720p).

defaultAutoArchiveDuration.description: Default duration in minutes for newly created threads (60, 1440, 4320, 10080).

defaultSortOrder.description: Default sort order for forum/media channels (0 for latest activity, 1 for creation date).

defaultForumLayout.description: Default forum layout (0 not set, 1 list view, 2 gallery view).

defaultThreadRateLimitPerUser.description: Initial rate limit per user for newly created threads.

id.description: The ID of the created channel

guildId.description: The ID of the guild the channel belongs to

position.description: The sorting position of the channel

parentId.description: The ID of the parent category

bitrate.description: The bitrate of the voice channel

userLimit.description: The user limit of the voice channel

actions.description: Create a message in Discord.
actions.name: create-message

channelId.description: The ID of the channel to send the message to. Example: "1504353981911273533"

content.description: The message content (max 2000 characters). One of content, embeds, components, sticker_ids, or files is required.

embeds.description: Array of embed objects. Up to 10 embeds.

messageReference.description: Reference to a message to reply to.

actions.description: Add a reaction to a Discord message.
actions.name: create-reaction

channel_id.description: Channel ID where the message is located. Example: "1504364254634180618"

message_id.description: Message ID to add the reaction to. Example: "1234567890123456789"

emoji.description: Emoji to add as a reaction. Can be a unicode emoji (e.g., "👍") or custom emoji format (e.g., "emoji_name:emoji_id"). Example: "👍" or "custom_emoji:123456789"

actions.description: Create a role in Discord
actions.name: create-role

name.description: Name of the role, max 100 characters. Example: "Moderators"

permissions.description: Bitwise value of the enabled/disabled permissions. Example: "66321471"

colors.description: Role colors object with primary, secondary, and tertiary colors

hoist.description: Whether the role should be displayed separately in the sidebar. Default: false

icon.description: The role's icon image data (if the guild has ROLE_ICONS feature)

unicode_emoji.description: The role's unicode emoji as a standard emoji (if the guild has ROLE_ICONS feature)

mentionable.description: Whether the role should be mentionable. Default: false

actions.description: Start a Discord thread from an existing message
actions.name: create-thread-from-message

channel_id.description: The ID of the channel containing the message. Example: "123456789012345678"

message_id.description: The ID of the message to create a thread from. Example: "987654321098765432"

name.description: The name of the thread (1-100 characters). Example: "Discussion Thread"

auto_archive_duration.description: Duration in minutes to automatically archive the thread. One of: 60, 1440, 4320, 10080

rate_limit_per_user.description: Seconds to wait between messages (slowmode). Range: 0-21600

actions.description: Create a webhook in a Discord channel

channelId.description: The channel ID where the webhook will be created. Can also be provided via metadata. Example: "199737254929760256"

name.description: Name of the webhook (1-80 characters). Must not contain "clyde" or "discord" (case-insensitive).

avatar.description: Optional base64-encoded image data for the webhook avatar. Example: "data:image/png;base64,iVBORw0KGgo..."

type.description: Webhook type: 1 = Incoming, 2 = Channel Follower, 3 = Application
